_comment: Model recipe catalog for colab-llm-deploy. The orchestrator uploads this to /content/models.json; deploy_llm.py resolves config['model'] against it. vram_gb = steady-state estimate incl. context; min_vram_gb = hard tier gate.

deepseek-coder-6.7b-q4.notes: T4-ok. Code specialist; Ollama default quant is Q4_K_M.

phi4-14b-q4.notes: Needs >=24GB (L4/A10G tier), NOT a T4 recipe. Ollama library tag; default quant Q4_K_M. (No verified AWQ/FP8 Hub repo for Phi-4 was available, so this ships on Ollama rather than vLLM.)

qwen2.5-7b-awq.notes: T4-tight but workable (gpu-memory-utilization 0.90, ctx capped at 4096 on <30GB). A100-preferred for headroom. Pass hf_token in config for reliable Hub download.

qwen2.5-7b-q4.notes: Default T4 recipe. GGUF via Ollama library; OpenAI-compatible /v1.

qwen2.5-14b-q4.notes: Largest T4-ok recipe (~9GB GGUF Q4_K_M). Needs >=12GB VRAM.

qwen3.5-4b-q4.notes: T4-ok, light. Qwen3.5 4B, Ollama default quant (Q4_K_M).

qwen3.5-27b-q4.notes: Needs >=24GB (L4/A10G tier), NOT a T4 recipe.

gemma4-12b-q4.notes: T4-ok. Gemma 4 12B (Mar 2026, Apache 2.0), ~7GB Q4_K_M. Strong all-rounder.

gemma4-e4b-q4.notes: T4-ok, light. Gemma 4 E4B (8B/4.5B eff), ~5GB Q4_K_M.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: T4-tight. 20B MoE (~14GB MXFP4); most capable per-GB in class. Needs >=14GB VRAM.

mimo-v2.6-9b-q4.notes: T4-ok. Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 distill of Qwen 9B (~6GB Q4_K_M); Ollama pulls direct from HF via hf.co prefix.

clef-flash-9b.notes: Cloudflare Workers AI 9B decision model (Apache 2.0); typed decisions via POST /v1/systemone (needs Ollama >= 0.35). Official tag 11-12GB, NOT the smallest recipe. Request shape: {"model": <tag>, "state": "...", "questions": {"<name>": {"type": "noul"|"choice"|"score", "instructions": "...", "criteria": {"<candidate>": "<description>", ... (2-26, choice only)}}}}. Response: {"answers": {"<name>": {"type": ..., "noul": p | "choice": "<c>", "probabilities": {...}, "confidence": c}}}. NOTE: /api/generate is not meaningful for this model; use /v1/systemone.

qwen3-vl-8b-q4.notes: First vision-language recipe. 6.1GB official tag; requires Ollama >= 0.12.7. Text+Image input. Proven on T4 2026-10-09 (vision smoke test, 12s, 11.5/15.4GB VRAM).

nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b-q4.notes: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, released 2026-10-23: RL post-train of Google Gemma 4 E4B, 8B total / 4B effective, 64K context on the model card, temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95, thinking via chat-template enable_thinking. Ollama e4b-q4_K_M build ~7.9GB, T4-comfortable; driver caps the 64K card claim to 8192 on <30GB GPUs. REQUIRES Ollama >= 0.40.10 (support landed 2026-10-23; 0.35.1 fails the pull with HTTP 412). Official HF GGUF fallback (same weights): nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB / Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-Q4_K_M.gguf (6.18GB).

saluki-27b-iq2.notes: Underdog's 2-bit compression of Qwen3.8-27B (qwen3.5 arch, 7.89GB). Needs llama.cpp >= b11493 (driver pins b11552 + cudart bundle; without cudart the server silently falls back to CPU). Serve flags: --jinja -ngl 99 -fa on. Thinking on by default (disable via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false); temp 0.6/top_p 0.95/top_k 20 for reasoning, temp 0 for fast tool calls. Tool calling verified live on T4 2026-10-11 (well-formed tool_calls). ctx 8192 tested; 32k per model card not tested on T4.

qwen3.8-27b-iq2.notes: LOCAL TEST RECIPE (not pushed): Qwen3.8-27B at UD-IQ2_XXS (7.27GB GGUF). Q4_K_M (16.46GB) does not fit a T4.

gemma4-26b-a4b-iq2.notes: LOCAL TEST RECIPE (not pushed): Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it at UD-IQ2_XXS (9.92GB GGUF). Q4_K_M (16.95GB) does not fit a T4.

inkling-2-mini-q3.notes: Thinking Machines Lab Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B total / 3.4B active looped MoE, Apache 2.0, 2026-11-20). Unsloth Mainline_Support file (NOTE: literal '.gguf_file' suffix on HF; llama.cpp loads by magic, not extension). 13.63GB, 96.3% top-1 per Unsloth table. Needs llama.cpp >= b12600 (inkling2_loop, PR #32694; tokenizer fix PR #32799 ~b12641); driver pins b12669. Serve flags: --jinja -ngl 99 -fa on. Vendor temp 1.0 default; reasoning_effort none does NOT fully disable reasoning; repetitive reasoning loops possible. Fallbacks if OOM/load fails: UD-IQ3_XXS (11.66GB), Atomic AD-IQ3_S, UD-Q2_K_XL (9.14GB). FAILED on T4 2026-11-24: loaded and answered (2+2 correct, ~25 tok/s decode) but llama-server crashed with CUDA OOM in cudaGraphInstantiate during the deep-test stream probe; VRAM after load was 14,885/15,360 MiB (~475 MiB headroom). Do NOT use on T4.

inkling-2-mini-iq3.notes: Thinking Machines Lab Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B total / 3.4B active looped MoE, Apache 2.0, 2026-11-20). Unsloth Mainline_Support file (literal '.gguf_file' suffix on HF). 11.66GB, 94.7% top-1 per Unsloth table. Fallback after UD-Q3_K_XL (13.63GB) CUDA-OOM-crashed on T4 with only ~475 MiB VRAM headroom. Needs llama.cpp >= b12600 (inkling2_loop); driver pins b12669. Serve flags: --jinja -ngl 99 -fa on. Vendor temp 1.0 default; reasoning trace counts against max_tokens — use generous budgets. GREEN on T4 2026-11-24 (cyc236ha): deep test 29/31 scored, 30/31 on inspection (tool 5/6, reasoning 12/12, needle 2/2 @10.3k/13.1k, ZH 3/3, temp-0 consistent); decode 23.6 tok/s, TTFT 0.41s, prefill 131 tok/s; VRAM 14,025 MiB @16k. Vision: mmproj-Inkling-2-Mini-F16.gguf (AtomicChat, 0.64GB) describe-test correct in 9.4s, VRAM 14,735 MiB — driver has no mmproj support; --mmproj was passed manually. ctx 32768 OOMs at load (3,365 MiB compute-buffer alloc fails); 16384 is the T4 max. Agentic test 2026-11-24 (kyu009009, same recipe): 13/14 corrected — multi-step 3/3, error recovery 2/2, code 2/3 (bug-fix task failed twice, systematic: model reads the TypeError but never calls write_file, burns turns re-running unrelated scripts), planning 2/2, memory 1/1, tool discipline 2/2, belief update 1/1; harness inkling-2-mini-agentic-test.py, doc docs/inkling-2-mini-agentic-test.md. Extensive agentic test 2026-11-24 (cyc236es): 39/41 corrected (36/41 as-run) — tool loops 7/7, error recovery 4/5, code 9/10, planning 6/6, memory 3/3, discipline 4/4, belief 3/3, long-context 3/3; probe bug-fix weakness is prompt-sensitive (state-the-fix variant passes); remaining fails are loop-termination (cheapest-search spiral, 33 searches; fix verified but no final answer), both reproduced identically on rerun. Harness inkling-2-mini-agentic-test-ext.py, doc docs/inkling-2-mini-agentic-test-ext.md.

training_probes_note: Training-track probes (2026-11-24/25), NOT serving recipes: each model was probed for NF4 QLoRA training on a free Colab T4 (transformers, one real training step), not deployed via deploy_llm.py. None of these is marked proven_t4 for inference/serving. deploy.py reads only models['models']; this key is documentation for the arXiv digest training track. Default stays Qwen3.5-9B. Full evidence: docs/small-model-training-probes-2026-11-25.md.

alpie-seed-9b.capability: reasoning 8/8, tool-JSON 2/3, needle 4k PASS (8k OOM - T4 SDPA limit), decode 9.5 tok/s; Chinese/temp-0 not measured (battery aborted at 8k OOM)
alpie-seed-9b.recipe_notes: transformers 5.22.1 shipped; NF4 double-quant bf16, LoRA r16 (3.93M trainable); 18.8 GB single-file download slow unauthenticated - use a HF token

twil-8b.capability: reasoning 7/8, tool-JSON 1/3 strict (2/3 effective - single-tool output was correct JSON but ```json-fenced), Chinese 3/3, temp-0 1/1, needle 4k PASS (8k OOM), decode 9.8 tok/s
twil-8b.recipe_notes: transformers 5.22.1 shipped; NF4, LoRA r16 (17.04M trainable); verbose thinking traces - use a generous generation budget; research/education only (non-commercial license)

sensenova-loop-9b.capability: reasoning 4/8, tool-JSON 3/3, Chinese 3/3, temp-0 1/1, decode 1.7 tok/s; needle not measured
sensenova-loop-9b.recipe_notes: trust_remote_code (custom modeling_sensenova_loop.py); pass use_cache=False explicitly on all nested configs (harness fix, not a model defect); transformers 5.22.1; budget 2-6x a Qwen3.5-class run

qwen3.5-4b.capability: 18/21; tool-JSON 3/3, reasoning 5/8, needle 4k+8k PASS, Chinese 3/3 (genuinely correct), temp-0 1/1, decode 10.8 tok/s
qwen3.5-4b.recipe_notes: pip uninstall -y torchao (shipped 0.10.0) or drop conv1d from LoRA targets; DeltaNet LoRA proven - all 248 LoRA B grads nonzero, 32.46M trainable; depthwise conv1d kernels (groups=8192) stay frozen; reference DeltaNet kernels unless causal-conv1d + flash-linear-attention installed; base-only step 1.8 s / peak 3.33 GB

lfm3-1.7b.capability: 17/21; reasoning 7/8, tool-JSON 1/3 (raw JSON - emits native <tool_call> format), needle 4k+8k PASS, instruction 2/2, temp-0 1/1, decode 18.0 tok/s; Chinese 3/3 is a substring artifact
lfm3-1.7b.recipe_notes: requires trust_remote_code=True (custom modeling code); pip uninstall -y torchao; score tools in native <tool_call> format, not raw JSON; 13 depthwise conv kernels (~186k params) stay frozen under PEFT LoRA

dory-4b.capability: 17/21; tool-JSON 3/3, reasoning 4/8 (weakest in series), needle 4k+8k PASS, Chinese 3/3, temp-0 1/1, decode 5.1 tok/s
dory-4b.recipe_notes: requires transformers git main (>=5.24); shipped 5.22.1 fails at load (layer_types validation); LoRA on the shared recurrent block trains stably at 1 step, loop count 2; loop count 4 / multi-step stability untested

minicpm5-2b.capability: 15/21 (lowest); tool-JSON 2/3, reasoning 5/8, instruction 1/2, needle 4k+8k PASS, Chinese 3/3, temp-0 1/1, decode 11.8 tok/s
minicpm5-2b.recipe_notes: cleanest port - native transformers 5.22.1, standard Llama, no workarounds; fallback only if both Qwen3.5-4B and LFM3 are unavailable
